title: TSM 0.0.0.9000
text: outcome column now matched exactly. TSM() get_LPOCV() used locate grepl("y", colnames(x)), feature whose name merely contained letter “y” (myelin, density, …) silently treated outcome dropped candidate features, data.frame y column pass validation. Every feature now considered possible representative. selection loop stopped one feature short, last survivor never picked matter good AUC (bundled demo input, F19 never looked ). single-remaining-feature case old guard working around now handled explicitly. Missing values longer break run. Correlations use use = "pairwise.complete.obs" explicit NA guard threshold test, models fitted (scored) complete cases, final roc() call longer fails “Response predictor must vectors length”. outcome column validated properly: y containing NA now rejected, y holding values 0/1 raises clear error instead vector-recycling warning. Non-numeric feature columns missing y also get explicit messages. get_LPOCV() returns plain unnamed scalar rather value named "TRUE", selects case/control pair row position, non-contiguous non-numeric row names longer matter. zero-variance feature longer sends selection loop spinning forever.
